notes: The ground this build owns. West: 10 m beyond the west ballast edge at the station (the west platform and shelter of the north model stand on it), then along the ballast. South: the end of the station lot, then Normal Avenue's south curb. East: x -300, where the main model's College Avenue carriageway begins; the paved corner south-east of the field (drive mouth, dumpster enclosure, shrubs) stays with the main model, so the edge runs up the east side of the south lawn, 4.5 m outside the turf, and round the back of the east bleachers. North-east: 0.3 m outside the ring walk's outer arc (2 to 3 m chords of that arc), where the north model's retaining wall stands. North: the field's north plaza and the end of the digitised part of Carlisle Road. West arm: Normal Avenue to the edge of the fetched evidence at x -560.

supersede.notes: Patterns match 'mesh name material name' in the other sources' tiles. clip: their ground inside the footprint (triangles inside are removed, corners of straddling triangles are lowered). drop: things this build replaces (the main model's partial field at a wrong angle: lines, end zone blocks, goalpost, the south part of the east bleachers, one light pole, turf edge curbs; far-field houses).
